sharedRules.collectorRetention: one source collector maps to one native headless Referências; never Notas because native59102402 emits two collectors
sharedRules.fieldCase: exact native named parameter spelling, not accent/case folding
sharedRules.unprovedInput: unknown fields, dynamic group, layout/style fields including blank, malformed calls, protected/unknown parents retain whole source quietly
sharedRules.nativeCollision: native exact local alias/interface before foreign profile, including every raw argument and explicit blank; foreign source-looking fields do not activate in a native redirect
